name: Eulerian
description: Allows your website analytics to be managed using Eulerian.
project_description: Adds the Eulerian tracking system to your website. It injects the Eulerian analytics JavaScript tag on the pages you choose and builds a JavaScript datalayer (drupalSettings.eulerian.datalayer) that is pushed to Eulerian with EA_push(). Features include single-domain tracking, per-page visibility rules (all-except / listed-only / optional PHP), token-driven custom parameters, internal site-search tracking, Views search-key reporting via a display extender, Colorbox modal tracking, 403/404 status-code filtering, cross-device hashed User ID, translation-set unification, asynchronous loading, and an optional data-cleaning step following Eulerian's recommendations. Commerce cart, checkout and product datalayers are supplied by the bundled eulerian_commerce_* submodules.
